correctness.rationale: PASS. The pinned six-by-twenty-four ternary generator has full row rank and nonsingular Gram matrix over F3. Independently reconstructed all 3^6=729 codewords and all 56,631 nonzero-dimensional message subspaces using unique RREF pivot/free-entry normal forms; every subspace maps injectively to a code subspace. Support histograms give generalized weights (12,16,19,21,23,24), one 2D support-16 minimizer and 3D/4D minima with multiplicity three; the weight enumerator matches the submitted 729-word census. The three minimal dependent triples consist of disjoint coordinate triples {1,15,23},{2,5,11},{8,12,24}. No zero/proportional columns, 102 minimal 4-circuits and complete coordinate coverage by these circuits establish exact locality two on nine coordinates and three on the other fifteen. Full finite census is logically exhaustive and exact; this does not assert properties for other [24,6,12] codes.
